t: You're looking at St Ignatius Church, a large, listed Roman Catholic parish church on the corner of Stamford Hill and St Ann's Road, where it meets Tottenham High Road. The Jesuits founded it in 1894 and still minister here, as part of the Archdiocese of Westminster. It was designed by Benedict Williamson, who designed many Romanesque Revival churches across the country and who later became a Roman Catholic priest.
